استعديا (form X)
# اِسْتَعْدَيَا (istaʕdayā) /is.taʕ.da.jaː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِسْتَعْدَى (istaʕdā)
# اُسْتُعْدِيَا (ustuʕdiyā) /us.tuʕ.di.jaː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِسْتَعْدَى (istaʕdā)
# اِسْتَعْدِيَا (istaʕdiyā) /is.taʕ.di.jaː/: second-person dual imperative of اِسْتَعْدَى (istaʕdā)
